mapper.select: SELECT wo.*, m.name AS material_name, m.model AS material_model, m.standard AS material_standard, mc.name AS category_name, u.name AS basic_unit, u.ratio AS ratio, cu.username AS create_user_name, uu.username AS update_user_name FROM jsh_production_work_order wo LEFT JOIN jsh_material m ON wo.product_id = m.id AND IFNULL(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_material_category mc ON m.category_id = mc.id AND IFNULL(mc.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_unit u ON wo.unit_id = u.id AND IFNULL(u.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user cu ON wo.create_user = cu.id AND IFNULL(cu.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user uu ON wo.update_user = uu.id AND IFNULL(uu.delete_flag, '0') != '1' WHERE wo.id = #{id} AND IFNULL(wo.delete_flag, '0') != '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE jsh_production_work_order SET actual_start_time = #{actualStartTime}, actual_end_time = #{actualEndTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'
